test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
What is the value of the following expression ?

2² ((x^a)/(x^b))⁽a⁺b⁾ × 3² ((x^b)/(x^c))⁽b⁺c⁾ × 6⁻² ((x^c)/(x^a))⁽a⁺c⁾
solution:
**Concept used:-**

Properties of exponents and powers = a2 - b2 = (a + b)(a - b)

Calculation**:- **

Using the exponent property (a^n)/(a^m)=aⁿ⁻m in the given expression,

⇒ 2²(x)⁽a⁻b⁾⁽a⁺b⁾×3²(x)⁽b⁻c⁾⁽b⁺c⁾×6⁻²(x)⁽c⁻a⁾⁽c⁺a⁾

By using the formula, **a² - b² = (a + b)(a - b)**

⇒ 2²(x)⁽a²⁻b²⁾×3²(x)⁽b²⁻c²⁾×6⁻²(x)⁽c²⁻a²⁾ 

⇒ 2²(x)⁽a²⁻b²⁾×3²(x)⁽b²⁻c²⁾times(3×2)⁻²(x)⁽c²⁻a²⁾

By using the exponent property, **(a × b)m = am × bm**

⇒ 2²(x)⁽a²⁻b²⁾×3²(x)⁽b²⁻c²⁾times(3)⁻²times(2)⁻²(x)⁽c²⁻a²⁾

By using the property **am ****× aⁿ = a⁽m ⁺ ⁿ⁾** 

⇒ 2⁽²⁺⁽⁻²⁾⁾times 3⁽²⁺⁽⁻²⁾times x⁽a^{²-b²)+(b²-c²)+(c²-a²)}

By the property of exponents, i.e** a⁰ = 1**

⇒ 2⁰ × 3⁰ × x⁰ 

⇒ 1 × 1 × 1 = 1

**The value of the expression is 1.**
